text.m.home.t: LYNX SHARE: a lightweight open-source DAW that opens FL Studio and Ableton Live projects
text.m.home.d: LYNX SHARE is a free, open-source DAW for Windows, macOS and Linux with FL Studio's way of working: Channel rack, Piano roll, Playlist and Mixer. It opens .flp, .als and .flm projects and exports .flp and .als.
text.m.features.d: What LYNX SHARE does in the current release: the windows, the clip-launch layout, .flp, .als and .flm projects, built-in instruments and effects, and the plugin formats it hosts.
text.m.download.d: Download LYNX SHARE for Windows, macOS or Linux: installer, portable zip, dmg, AppImage and tar.gz, with install notes for each system.
text.m.updates.d: What is new, better and fixed in each LYNX SHARE release, newest first.
text.m.wiki.d: The LYNX SHARE manual: getting started, the windows, coming from FL Studio or Ableton Live, plugins, shortcuts, file formats and troubleshooting.
text.m.faq.d: Short answers about LYNX SHARE: price and licence, systems, FL Studio and Ableton Live projects, plugins, privacy and updates.
